title: RMP-SAM: Towards Real-Time Multi-Purpose Segment Anything

layout.note: Two halves side by side split by a dashed vertical line: on the left a three-row input column, the RMP-SAM box with rocket in the middle and a three-row output column; on the right a 2x2 grid of bubble plots, each titled below.

lesson: A teaser can pair a left panel that states the task as real inputs, one boxed model and real outputs lined up by row, with a right panel of identical bubble plots in which the model keeps the colour of its box, so the claim and the evidence read as one story.
